newsitem.title: USA: Rexene stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: Rexene stake raised by group.

text.p: A group including Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said they raised their stake in Rexene Corp to 13.21 percent, or 2,483,800 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 582,100 common shares bought between March 6 and March 13 at prices ranging from $13.4070 to $14 per share.

Earlier this month, the group filed a complaint to require the company to establish a record date for a special meeting that is no later than April 1. They also set the date for the special meeting of shareholders for April 30, 1997.

Rexene Corp, based in Dallas, Tx., manufactures and markets thermoplastic and petrochemical products, which are integral elements in the manufacture of wide variety of industrial and consumer products.
